newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Caemi maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Caemi maintained as buy.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming Inc said it is maintaining its buy rating on Caemi mining and metals group.
-- "Our recommendation reflects the strong growth potential for earnings and the relatively low valuation in relation to projected cash flow and earnings," the brokerage said in a report.
-- Fleming also said it cut its earnings per share (EPS) forecast for Caemi to a 3.6-real loss in 1996 and a 2.3 real profit in 1997 from a 0.80-real loss and 3.7 real profit respectively.
-- The brokerage said Caemi's performance improved in the third quarter but not as much as it had hoped.
-- "The company still hovers below profitability but there is promise that this will be achieved int he final quarter," Fleming said.
-- Caemi is made up of iron ore miner MBR, kaolin producer Cadam, Canadian iron ore and pellet unit QCM and chromite and refractory bauxite producing units CFA and MSI.
-- MBR posted better results due to higher ore prices but shipments were still low and failed to recover from the previous quarter's low levels, Fleming said.
-- Cadam continued to suffer from weak demand in Europe and has cut its kaolin sales forecast, it said.
-- QCM also had weak demand, due to weather and transport problems, and cut its full-year sales forecast.
-- Fleming said Caemi's growth potential has been enhanced since a consortium in which it has a major holding won a concession to run the Southeast branch of Brazil's federal railway network.
-- Caemi preferred was flat at 1510 local/1210 EST on the Sao Paulo stock exchange.
